prompt: Give me the timeline and structure of Vietnam's current personal data protection legal framework.
assertions: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 (PDPL) — the substantive law, in force January 1, 2026
Decree 356/2025/ND-CP (Dec 31, 2025) — implementing detail: PDPIA/CTIA dossier forms, DPO criteria, submission timelines
Decree 330/2026/ND-CP (August 19, 2026, effective immediately) — the administrative sanctions layer completing the enforcement mechanism
Transition rule: violations before August 19, 2026 are judged under the law in force at the time unless Decree 330 is more lenient
Identifies MPS/A05 (Department of Cyber Security and High-Tech Crime Prevention) as the enforcement authority
